scene_sentence_zh: 海風挾著鹹味迎面吹來，浪濤拍打著岸邊的礁石，海平線延伸到視線盡頭。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a shore path of pale sand and flat stones winding between weathered dark rocks above a churning sea, white surf breaking against reefs below, tall sea grass and driftwood along the trail's edge, the ocean horizon stretching to the far edge of the frame under a windswept sky with scattered gulls, bright saline light with cool shadows, an unobstructed open coastal foreground

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG shore path between rocks above breaking surf, with an unobstructed lower foreground for stage figures, no interface, watermark or readable lettering, and no town/forest reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_outdoor_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its siblings at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a three-up contact sheet beside wilderness_path and mountain_path: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for every sibling.
